item.title: VIP Service by Video Call: "Don't Worry, I'll Take Care of It"
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers VIP Service by Video Call: “Don’t Worry, I’ll Take Care of It” Video calling is the channel that sectors like banking and insurance reserve for their best customers. What’s new isn’t the channel. It’s that it no longer has to be reserved for them alone. There is never someone available in the place, and at the moment, the customer most needs it. That isn’t a staffing failure or a matter of attitude: the person who can resolve it is almost never where the problem appears, in the minute it appears.

item.title: The Phone We Stopped Using — Except in Every Hotel Room
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers The Phone We Stopped Using — Except in Every Hotel Room That landline is still there, in every hotel room, whatever the category. Sometimes there are even two — one on the nightstand, one in the bathroom. Younger guests have already made up their minds about it: they no longer know how to use it, or want to. Street phone booths disappeared entirely, and nobody missed them.
